mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its recent trend compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 3.0% annualized), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate consistently signals weakening economic activity and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as a result of lower corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it indicates a severe labor market contraction that increases recession risk and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and an increase in the federal funds rate signals a contractionary monetary policy during a supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate output and higher financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units, it indicates a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 2000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
